bibl.title: Representation and novelty in Aeschylus' Theoroi.
bibl.seg: Oliver Thomas, Representation and novelty in Aeschylus' Theoroi.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XVIII, 2162 (= MP3 42; LDAB 117). - Argues in favour of the view that in Theoroi (a.k.a. Isthmiastai) the satyrs had absconded from Dionysus' choral training, and dedicate a set of votive masks on Poseidon's Isthmian temple. The plot rests on a blurring of the distinctions between satyr, human character, and human performer.
